use_case: A terminal pair-programming assistant: you add files from your git repo to the chat, describe a change or bug fix, and the LLM edits the code with SEARCH/REPLACE diffs, auto-commits the change, and can re-run your linter/tests to fix failures.
not_for: The model does not call tools on its own. Edits come back as text blocks, and shell commands are only suggested; the user confirms before they run
Not a long-horizon agent that plans and explores by itself: the user has to add the relevant files to the chat
Not built for data/SQL, ops/infra, or non-coding work
evidence: README.md calls it "AI Pair Programming in Your Terminal" and lists repo map, git auto-commit, lint and test, web pages/images, and 100+ languages. aider/coders/editblock_prompts.py:8-29 sets the SEARCH/REPLACE edit protocol and says to ask the user to add files. aider/commands.py has cmd_web (219), cmd_commit (337), cmd_lint (356), cmd_undo (553), cmd_git (967), cmd_test (993) and cmd_run (1013).
